title: Skin111’s Eva Alexandridis and Olivia de Rothschild Talk Longevity, Instinctive Entrepreneurship
summary: At WWD x SKP Global Fashion & Beauty Summit in Wuhan, Eva Alexandridis and Olivia de Rothschild discussed the formative experiences that shaped their career and their personal understanding of longevity.
